name: Fishing trip

seo.title: Fishing Trip from Koh Lanta | Secret Travel & Tour
seo.metaDescription: Fishing from Koh Lanta on a private wooden raft in Ao Lanta: four hours on the water, gear and bait included, seafood lunch cooked on board. From 3,900 THB.

draft.title: Fishing Trip Koh Lanta – Longtail or Private Raft

lead: A half day of fishing from a private wooden raft in the calm waters of Ao Lanta, with a fresh seafood lunch on the raft.
promise: Half a day fishing from a private wooden raft

facts.label: Raft
facts.value: Private wooden raft in Ao Lanta, 09:30–14:00

options.label: Private raft, fishing and seafood lunch
options.note: Four hours on the water, fishing gear and bait included. The price covers 1 or 2 people. Each extra person adds 1,800 THB, so a group of 3 pays 5,700 THB. Children from 3 to 9 pay 1,500 THB each.

steps.text: Pickup at your hotel, then check-in at Thung Yee Peng pier at 10:00.
The raft crosses the mangrove forest.
Fishing in the calm waters of Ao Lanta.
Time to relax and learn how the local fishermen live and work.
Fresh seafood lunch on the raft, with drinks and fruit.
More fishing, photos or time to relax.
The raft cruises back through the mangrove.
At the pier, then the transfer to your hotel.

included: Hotel transfer both ways, within the Koh Lanta area
On the raft: bait, a local guide, life jackets and insurance
On the raft: seafood lunch, drinking water, soft drinks and seasonal fruit

beforeYouBook.pickup: Raft: pickup at your hotel around 09:30, check-in at Thung Yee Peng pier at 10:00.
beforeYouBook.cancellation: Please tell us at least 24 hours before.

faq.a: No. The gear and the bait are on board, and a local guide is with you.
Couples, families and friends. The raft is for your group only.

legacyText.title: Fishing Trip from Koh Lanta | Secret Travel & Tour
intro: Two versions. The longtail goes out to sea off Koh Lanta with a local captain. The raft stays in the sheltered bay of Ao Lanta, on the mangrove side, and the crew cooks fresh seafood on board for lunch.
legacyText.cardDescription: A fishing trip on a longtail off the coast of Koh Lanta.
goodToKnow: The raft is private, from one or two people. From three people the price is per person. Children from 3 to 9 have a child rate.
The longtail trip is a half day too. Tell us which one you prefer, or ask us which suits your group.
legacyText.priceNote: For the longtail version, ask us for the price.
legacyText.caption: Sunset catch
